data.gender_notes: Merrill is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Old English word 'mere' meaning 'sea' and 'hele' meaning 'ruler'. This name means 'brave rule' or 'ruler of the sea'. In Christian tradition, Merrill is a name associated with courage and strength. The name Merrill carries the meaning “Brave rule” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Merrill usually hope their child will grow to embody brave rule and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Merrill belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Brave rule.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Merrill total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_hebrew.name: מריל
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The Hebrew name Merrill is derived from the Hebrew words 'mar' (light) and 'el' (God). It means 'God is my light' or 'God illuminates my way'.

in_greek.name: Μερίλλος
in_greek.long_meaning: The Greek name Merrill is derived from the Greek words 'mēros' (mighty) and 'theos' (God). It means 'mighty warrior of God' or 'strong in God'.

in_latin.name: Merrillus
in_latin.long_meaning: The Latin name Merrill is derived from the Latin word 'merulus' or 'merrulus', which is a diminutive of 'merus' (complete, perfect). In Roman mythology, Mercury was the god of commerce, travelers, thieves, and merchants. The name Merrillus may have been used as a nickname for a soldier or traveler, meaning 'little Mercury'.

in_english.name: Merrill
in_english.long_meaning: The English name Merrill is derived from the Old English words 'myrge' (little) and 'hylle' (bright or shining one). It means 'little bright one' or 'shining one'.

data.cultural_impact: The name Merrill is a testament to the heroic spirit of the sea, reflecting the historical significance of seafaring and maritime exploration. For individuals named Merrill, this name carries with it a strong sense of adventure and an innate connection to the ocean. Furthermore, the name's roots in Old English language indicate a deep connection to the history and culture of the Germanic peoples.
data.spiritual_significance: Merrill is a name imbued with spiritual meaning and depth. The name's roots in Old English translate to 'ruler of the sea' or 'brave rule'. In Christian tradition, the name Merrill symbolizes the courage and strength found in God's protection and guidance, particularly in challenging situations or on dangerous journeys. This name is a reminder of the divine sovereignty over all of God's creation, including the vast and mysterious expanse of the sea.
